title: XSS trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for xss trace events.

defences.description: Which protections the site has switched on.

encoding.description: Output encoding: none, the & < > " escaper, or an encoder chosen per sink.

sanitizer.description: Whether an allowlist HTML sanitizer runs before rendering rich text.

csp.description: The Content-Security-Policy header value, or null when none is sent.

httpOnly.description: Whether the session cookie is marked HttpOnly.

cookie.description: The session cookie an XSS payload is usually after.

httpOnly.description: Whether document.cookie is allowed to see it.

stolen.description: Whether the current render ended with the cookie being read by injected script.

stored.description: Untrusted values persisted by the site, as they were typed.

dangerous.description: Whether the stored string contains markup that could execute when printed.

render.description: The render being traced (null before the first one).

source.description: How the untrusted value reached the page.

sink.description: Where in the document the value lands; untranslated.

input.description: The untrusted value exactly as it was typed.

output.description: The value after sanitizing and encoding, as it goes into the page.

encoded.description: Whether an output encoder actually ran for this render.

sanitized.description: Whether the sanitizer changed the value.

html.description: The finished markup the browser receives; null before the page is built.

outcome.description: How far the current render got and what the browser decided.

stage.description: Progress: value received, markup built, markup parsed, verdict final.

injected.description: Whether the untrusted value escaped its slot and became markup or code.

executed.description: Whether the injected code actually ran.

blockedBy.description: Which layer stopped the payload; null when nothing had to, or nothing did.

nodes.description: What the browser made of the markup: template parts plus the untrusted part.

kind.description: Template markup, an inert text node, or executable content.

danger.description: Whether this node is the untrusted value having become code.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

injections.description: Renders where the untrusted value became markup instead of text.

executions.description: Renders where injected code actually ran.

blockedByCsp.description: Injections the Content-Security-Policy refused to execute.

neutralized.description: Renders where the value stayed data.
